ResearchProjectDef.label: humoralism
ResearchProjectDef.description: An early theory of the mind that treats mood as a balance of bodily humors. Crude, but it lets a counselor use herbal preparations during therapy and mend psyche scars a little more effectively.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cognitive behavioral therapy
ResearchProjectDef.description: A structured, evidence-based approach to reframing harmful thought patterns. Lets a counselor use industrial medicine during therapy and repair deeper psyche scars more effectively.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EMDR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Eye movement desensitization and reprocessing: a spacer-era protocol that can fully resolve even the deepest psyche scars. With glitterworld medicine and a guided contemplation, it can carry a mind past its old limits into lasting clarity.
